features.name: time_of_day_normalized
features.description: Departure time normalized to [0,1] across the day (minutes since midnight / 1440).
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized scalar that supports approximately linear separation along time-of-day risk gradients.

features.name: is_late_afternoon_evening
features.description: Indicator/severity that the flight departs in the higher-congestion late afternoon to evening window (roughly 15:00-22:00).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a linearly weighted indicator capturing peak-congestion departure windows.

features.name: is_early_morning
features.description: Indicator for early-morning departures (before 7am) which typically have lower delay propagation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear contrast feature for off-peak early departures.

features.name: length_zscore
features.description: Standardized flight length using training-fold mean/std, clipped for robustness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides centered/scaled length suitable for linear SVM margins.

features.name: log_length
features.description: Log-transformed flight length to compress long-haul tail and linearize relationships.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces skew in Length, helping linear projection capture monotone effects.

features.name: time_length_interaction
features.description: Multiplicative interaction between normalized time-of-day and normalized length, capturing later long flights.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows linear SVM to weight combined late-departure long-haul risk.

features.name: expected_arrival_overflow
features.description: Fractional overflow into the next day if Time + Length exceeds 1440 minutes; 0 otherwise.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes red-eye/overnight arrivals which correlate with operational disruption.

features.name: is_weekend
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures weekly seasonality as a linear offset.

features.name: is_midweek_peak
features.description: Indicator for the busiest midweek days (Wednesday=3, Thursday=4) per training distribution.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes high-traffic weekday effect for linear separation.

features.name: same_airport_indicator
features.description: Indicator that origin and destination airports are identical (rare/irregular routing).
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a sparse linear flag for unusual itineraries.

features.name: congestion_propensity_score
features.description: Semantic score (0-1) estimating airport-level congestion propensity based on origin airport identity, using generic hub knowledge: major hubs (ATL, ORD, DFW, DEN, LAX, IAH, PHX, JFK, EWR, SFO, LGA) score near 1.0; mid-size airports score around 0.5; small regional airports score near 0.1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth continuous severity measure linking origin airport to operational congestion, improving linear margin separation.

features.name: carrier_operational_reliability
features.description: Semantic score (0-1) estimating carrier operational reliability from generic industry knowledge of the Airline code; legacy/major carriers with strong on-time records score higher (closer to 1.0), low-cost or regional feeders with tighter turnarounds score lower (closer to 0.2).
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous carrier-quality proxy that supports a linear weighting in SVM decision function.
